summary: Sanofi filed a Form 6-K with a press release reporting Q1 2026 earnings: sales of €10,509M (+13.6% CER), business EPS of €1.88 (+14.0% CER). The filing notes completion of the Dynavax acquisition and €921M of a €1B share buyback programme, but these are prior events with no new deal terms. The press release also mentions an interim CEO and upcoming CEO change, but it is a routine quarterly update, not a special-situation event. No transaction or strategic action is announced in this filing.
